judge_notes: Claims checked against arXiv HTML of the 22 plan papers (eval/sets/plans/survey-rlhf.json). Worked-example arithmetic labelled as hypothetical was recomputed and counted separately from source claims.

reasons.A: Claim-style noun-phrase headings with a coherent lineage arc (L11, L57, L240, L478, L768, L841). No H1, math only in $$. Deductions: the GRPO KL estimator equation appears twice (L725, L788); thin subsections '### 활용과 탐색을 나눈 반복 RLHF' (L687-689, one paragraph, no result) and '### 얻는 것과 치르는 비용' (L691-695, opens with the fragment '앞서 본 수렴 보장과 라운드별 생성·판정 비용, 작은 검증 규모가 이 계보의 득실입니다.'); one-sentence section intro at L494.
reasons.B: Natural 입니다-register Korean with no register breaks. Deductions: '앞서 본' 35 times (formulaic back-reference); a citation after almost every sentence, e.g. Christiano cited about 20 times in L63-107, which hurts readability; L366 '이때 손실은 −logσ(0.3)≈0.554' with the setup sentence missing, so the reader does not know what 0.3 is.
reasons.C: One running example (Reddit TL;DR pair A/B) is introduced at L17 and reused in nearly every lineage (L28, L173, L330, L576, L628, L636, L806). Cross-lineage links (e.g., L276 tying Gao's early-stopping result back to Ziegler/InstructGPT) are accurate. Deductions: L312 '앞서 언급한 중간 범위로 클램핑' points to a 40-60 range never stated earlier; L366 worked example has lost its premise.
reasons.D: Hard steps get labelled hypothetical worked examples at the point of use: BT loss 0.69/0.37 (L83), noise-mixing 0.67 (L85), KL-shaped reward 1.7 (L127), Gao peak d=5 and d=e^3 (L262), odds ratio 2.25 (L542), SimPO margin (L576), Nash-MD mixing (L628), SPPO targets (L658), GRPO advantages +1.73/-0.58 (L734). All recomputed correctly. Minor: L366 example broken.
reasons.E: 46 source figures placed where discussed and referred to descriptively (no 'Figure 3' numbering); equations for every core loss. Deductions: duplicated KL estimator (L725/L788); several figure paragraphs only restate the caption (L554, L93); final table L818-839 mixes settings and results.
reasons.F: 3 of 29 sampled claims unsupported or wrong (10.3%): SPPO LC win rate stated as 28.52% (L679) where the paper and the post's own table (L837) give 28.53%; table cell '1.3B RLHF ... 61% (SFT 43%)' (L822) attributes 43% to an unspecified SFT when it is the 10x-larger supervised model; '비교 대부분을 계약자 한 명이 라벨링' (L222) misreads 'most comparisons are only labeled by 1 contractor' as one person labelling most comparisons.
reasons.S1: Limitations come from the papers' own text (e.g., L380 DPO, L428 IPO, L560 ORPO, L642 online IPO). Table cells are noun phrases in Korean. Deductions: four comparison-table 'result' cells are settings or prose, not results: Llama 2 'PPO KL 계수 β 설정' (L829), CAI 'SL-CAI 원칙 수 16개' (L826), IPO '참 선호 0.8, 경험적 선호 1 예시' (L831), Online IPO '요약 과제 온라인 IPO 대 타 알고리즘 승률 비교 (최고 평균)' (L836); ORPO cell '87.92% / 11.33%' does not say AlpacaEval 1.0 vs 2.0 (L835).

claim_headings.evidence: L57 '비교로 배운 보상 모델, KL에 묶인 PPO, 그 대가로 나타나는 과최적화', L478 '보상 모델 없이도 되풀이되는 과최적화'; no 다-form headings.

running_example.evidence: TL;DR A/B pair introduced at L17 and reused at L28, L173, L330, L576, L628, L636, L806, L876.

mechanism_choice_formula_example.evidence: e.g., Ziegler KL penalty: problem (L121) -> roles and reason (L129) -> formula (L124) -> worked number (L127); SimPO L564-576.

facts_said_once.evidence: Table numbers are mostly new, but 320 GPU-days appears at L179 and L822, the KL estimator at L725 and L788, and '앞서 본' back-references are used 35 times.

numbers_with_variant_scope_unit.evidence: Most numbers carry model and setting (L679, L736); exceptions L822 '(SFT 43%)' and L835 ORPO cell without AlpacaEval version.

nothing_invented.evidence: All worked examples are marked '가상의' (L83, L127, L262, L542); no unsourced equations found.

writer_assessment_at_end.evidence: '이 글은 …라고 봅니다' judgments at L695, L794, L816, L868, L880 distinguish the writer's view from the papers'.

length_fitted_to_difficulty.evidence: Hard methods get depth (DPO, IPO, GRPO), but RLHF Workflow gets one paragraph (L687-689) and the online-lineage wrap-up is a fragment (L691-695).

type_specific_shape.evidence: Survey shape (intro, lineages, cross-cutting, comparison, insight, conclusion) present; numbers are not confined to one table (L143, L153, L222, L679 carry many body numbers) and the table has non-result cells.

korean_style.evidence: Correct register throughout; overuse of '앞서 본' (35) and per-sentence citation repetition.

reasons.A: Lineage sections with per-section comparison tables. Deductions: topic-name headings instead of claim headings ('## 들어가며: 왜 선호 최적화인가' L11, '## RLHF의 기초: 보상 모델과 PPO 파이프라인' L56, '### DPO: 언어 모델 안에 숨은 보상 모델' L278); markup that breaks MathJax/blog lint: L162-163 '=&' and '\\' inside $$ without an aligned environment, L195 '\beta_{\text{bo$n$}}' puts '$' inside math; '맺으며' (L720-726) restates earlier sections.
reasons.B: Clear, precise Korean with good intuition sentences (L108 proportional controller, L304 DPO gradient). Deductions: input-meta wording that reads as an abstract summary ('논문 요지는 RLHF와 \'비슷한\' 성능이라고만 밝혀' L272, '논문 요지에는 … 수치가 제시되어 있지 않습니다' L585, '초록에는 실험적 검증이 제시되지 않습니다' L638); multi-sentence prose in table cells (L33-54, L686-699).
reasons.C: Good section transitions and synthesis paragraphs (L227-229, L397, L493, L594). Deductions: no running example; the same claims recur across the post, e.g., Mroueh's fixed-point result at L27, L54, L636, L703, L726 and DPO's 'binary classification loss' at L21, L41, L667; the final table repeats body numbers almost cell for cell.
reasons.D: Strong help on hard steps: BT noise-mixing bounds 0.05-0.95 (L82), K=9 -> 36 pairs (L154), DPO gradient weight derivation (L304), IPO analytic example (L336), clamping 0.9 -> 0.6 (L254), x−log x−1 ≥ 0 (L624). Fewer numeric worked examples than needed for SimPO/ORPO/SPPO; RRHF gets no equation.
reasons.E: 26 figures placed in context with descriptive references; per-lineage tables are a good idea. Deductions: tables with empty cells ('세부 미기술' ×6 at L222-225; '논문 요지에 명시되지 않음' L592); final table L684-699 duplicates body numbers in prose; some figure paragraphs only describe axes (L262, L445).
reasons.F: 5 of 35 sampled claims wrong or unsupported (14.3%): CAI labels described as ensembling judgments from every principle into one label (L252) where the paper samples one principle at random per comparison label; comparison table says Llama 2's RM loss and KL reference are '세부 미기술' (L225) although the paper gives the margin ranking loss and a KL penalty to π0; and three false meta-limitations from abstracts (L272 RLAIF, L585 RLHF Workflow, L638 Mroueh).
reasons.S1: Exactly the anti-pattern the criterion names: limitations taken from the input rather than the paper — '초록에는 실험적 검증이 제시되지 않습니다' (L638; the paper has an Experimental Validation appendix), '논문 요지에는 오프라인 방식 대비 향상 폭을 보여 주는 구체적 수치가 제시되어 있지 않습니다' (L585; the paper reports 31.3 vs 22.5 LC), '논문 요지는 RLHF와 \'비슷한\' 성능이라고만 밝혀' (L272). Table cells are full sentences (L33-54, L686-699), and numbers explained in sections are explained again in the final table.

A.reason: X has claim headings and clean math; Y has topic headings and two math-markup breaks (L162, L195).

B.reason: Both natural; X loses on '앞서 본' ×35 and citation spam, Y on abstract-meta phrasing and prose table cells.

C.reason: X's TL;DR running example ties all lineages; Y has none and repeats claims across sections.

D.reason: X gives correct numeric worked examples at each hard step; Y's intuition is strong but has fewer examples and thin cards.

E.reason: Both place figures well; Y's tables have empty '세부 미기술' cells and a final table that duplicates the body.

F.reason: X 3/29 (10.3%, one wrong digit plus two scope issues) vs Y 5/35 (14.3%, including a wrong mechanism and false limitations).

S1.reason: Y repeats the input-based-limitation anti-pattern three times; X's weak cells are setting-not-result.

overall.reason: X wins or ties every criterion. Neither post meets the F ≥ 9 gate.
